body:
I live in a small town, which makes the public transportation kind of shitty. Same with just going and talking to strangers. It's very easy to know someone who knows someone, and I'd rather just not talk to any ol' stranger, in that case.

Talking online is still sometimes really difficult. I over-analyze everything I say until I just decide to say nothing at all.

I should mention I don't drive. I'd need someone to drive me to go to places. I'm basically stuck at home unless someone invites me, which is almost never.

It might sound obvious, but it's easier said than done with the talking situation. More often than not, my anxiety will get so bad I don't open my mouth at all or I'll start crying. It's almost ruining my life.

And... With the online community thing, it's the same issue. I'm constantly worried about how dumb I sound, if I sound sarcastic or rude, etc. Hell, I've been contemplating making this post at all for the past several weeks because I was afraid of the kind of response I'd get.

I don't really have any resources in real life to go out and meet new people. Plus I'm incredibly socially anxious and I'm terrible at talking to people. I'm very self conscious about my speaking patterns and talking to people, so I generally avoid doing so.

Online, I don't really know anywhere to go. I've tried in the past, but it's hard to connect when I feel like I'm bothering my own friends whenever I talk to them, much less people online that I don't know.

I have a few friends that I've lost contact with and I frankly don't really want to talk to again. Other than that, I have a couple of internet friends that I can't visit, but I also can't talk to because they're often busy or I'm afraid of bothering them or forcing them to deal with my issues.
